Factory infrastructure

Ringer

Delegates to many coding CLIs without surrendering the definition of done.

ROLE IN THE FACTORY

The trust boundary

Ringer turns a prompt into a contract: isolated work, expected artifacts, an executable gate, bounded retry, and a durable receipt.

What it provides

A bounded capability with a clear handoff.

  • Parallel workers in isolated directories or Git worktrees
  • Configurable Codex, Claude, OpenCode, OpenRouter, and Grok Build lanes
  • Executable checks that decide PASS from the artifact itself
  • One retry supplied with real failure output rather than a vague correction
  • Per-attempt logs, harvested artifacts, history, and the Ringside live view

The handoff

01PMmanifest
02Ringerisolates
03CLIattempt
04Gateexecutes
05Receiptrecords

Why it matters

The check is the contract

A direct CLI call returns persuasive prose. Ringer evaluates the declared result and exits successfully only when the gate passes. This makes the worker replaceable while the delivery standard remains stable.
